$comment: Code the site shows, cut from the repository at build time by scripts/site-data.mjs
into src/data/generated/snippets.json. Pages read it through snippet(name) in
src/lib/facts.ts. Never paste code into a page: add an entry here.
Each entry names a repo-relative `file` and one of: nothing (the whole file);
`start` and `end` (substrings of the first and last lines, `endAfter` more lines);
`start` and `block: true` (to the next `end` at the start line's indentation); or
`json: {array, id}` (one object of a top-level array). `start` must be unique in
the file. `mustContain` and `mustNotContain` hold what the page says about the
code. The build and scripts/site-data.test.mjs fail when an anchor is gone, a
snippet comes out empty, longer than `maxLines` (default 30), or breaks a must.

snippets.name: platform-resource
snippets.title: A resource on the platform base
snippets.caption: One use line gives the resource audit, ownership, tenancy, soft delete and the policy set.

snippets.name: grant-union
snippets.title: The grant union every platform resource inherits
snippets.caption: Each authorize_if is one grant path. None subtracts: there is no forbid_if for row access.
snippets.start: # The union. Each clause is one grant path;

snippets.name: governed-effect
snippets.title: An action that needs a second person's approval
snippets.caption: The effects declaration ash_agent reads: an edit that reaches outside the application, approved by a committee member other than the requester, settled by asking when its answer is lost.

snippets.name: process-start
snippets.title: Starting a BPMN process from an action
snippets.caption: ash_bpmn starts the instance as the process actor, with the person who asked recorded as its starter and the request's correlation id.

snippets.name: recipe-pack
snippets.title: A pack: a process and the recipe that starts it
snippets.caption: Installed as drafts. Nothing runs until a person publishes the process and then the recipe.

snippets.name: compliance-rule
snippets.title: A compliance rule over facts
snippets.caption: An ash_rules rule filed under a gap that ash_compliance maps to a control. Missing evidence is unknown, never a pass.

snippets.name: platform-extensions
snippets.title: What the use line adds
snippets.caption: The extensions every platform resource gets from AshEnterprise.Platform.Resource. Audit, soft delete and the API surfaces each have an option to turn them off or on in the resource's own file.

snippets.name: getting-started
snippets.title: The first run
snippets.caption: From the README. Everything runs inside devenv, and nothing needs configuring for dev or test.

snippets.name: provider-operation
snippets.title: One declared operation on an external service
snippets.caption: ash_operations turns this into a generic action with a code interface. The call is not idempotent, so a lost answer is reconciled through another declared read instead of being sent again.

snippets.name: agent-tools
snippets.title: Tools are existing actions
snippets.caption: An ash_ai tool names an action a resource already has. A model that calls it runs that action as the person asking, through the same policies.

snippets.name: control-evidence
snippets.title: A criterion with its owner, evidence producer and test
snippets.caption: From docs/controls.json. It names who owns the criterion, what produces its evidence and the test that proves it; it carries no status.
